_: Higgsfield BACKGROUND PLATES for the App Store panels on #apps. Each plate is a SCENE ONLY — no phone, no device, no text, no logo, no hands, nothing to read. The phone, its screenshot and the headline are composited on top afterwards by scripts/panels.mjs, which is why the model is never asked to draw interface type: it garbles it, and the panels are shown large enough to see that. Every plate must leave the CENTRE-LOWER two thirds visually calm (that is where the phone lands) and the TOP THIRD clean and darker/simpler (that is where the headline lands). 3:4 portrait, 2K.
shared_style: cinematic product-photography backdrop, shallow depth of field, soft volumetric light, fine film grain, no text, no watermark, no logo, no people, no hands, no phone, no screen, no device of any kind, empty centre, generous negative space in the upper third
